scenario: I lied to my boss about finishing a report so I could leave work early.
sentences: The trust was damaged by the employee because the truth was withheld from the supervisor.
The employee's needs were accommodated by the employer because the early departure was approved by the supervisor.
The productivity was hindered by the deception because the report was not actually completed.
The reputation was harmed by the action because the dishonesty was discovered by the boss.
